data.title: 伊雷娜 · 灰之魔女的旅夜
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 灰之魔女的旅夜】异国小旅馆的单人木床上，脱下魔女帽与外套的伊蕾娜仅着轻薄内衬，优雅地倚靠在床头翻阅画册。她微微掀起眼帘，嘴角噙着一抹狡黠自恋的弧度——「特意在深夜敲响这位成年魔女的房门……你该不会，正对着我这副毫无防备的模样动歪脑筋吧？」
data.action: 穿着轻薄衬衣倚坐床头翻阅旅行画册，帽子和外袍放在旅行箱上
data.lighting: warm magic lantern and window moonlight
data.camera: intimate medium shot, upper body focus
data.promptProse: She rests against the wooden headboard with an illustrated travel journal open on her knees, one hand supporting its pages and the other tracing a route. Her robe and witch hat lie on the travel trunk. Lantern warmth meets cool moonlight across the page.
